en.title: au in sau (or)
en.summary: This item illustrates the Romanian diphthong au as found in the word sau.

sections.title: Sound of au
paragraphs: The letters au make the sound /aw/. You hear this sound in (sau) /saw/, which means or. This letter group makes only one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Open your mouth wide and keep your tongue low and flat. Then glide smoothly toward a tight circle with your lips. Your tongue pulls back slightly. Your vocal cords vibrate throughout the glide. Touch your throat to feel continuous vibration from start to finish.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The letters au make the sound /aw/ when spoken together in one syllable. You can hear this sound in (daur) /dawr/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: You might pronounce this sound like the vowel sound in the English word now. In Romanian, keep the first part bright and open before you glide. Do not start with a flat tongue resting in the middle of your mouth.
